title: Counting Frobenius extensions over local function fields
summary: We determine the asymptotic growth of extensions of local function fields of characteristic p counted by discriminant, where the Galois group is a subgroup of the affine group AGL_1(p). More general, we solve the corresponding counting problems for all groups which arise in a tower of a cyclic extension of order p over a cyclic extension of degree d coprime to p. This in particular give answers for certain non-abelian groups including S_3, dihedral groups of order 2p, and many Frobenius groups.
